1. J'analyse (sans rien modifier) unique: 1. I analyze (without changing anything) only: Temp Files, Web Browser Caches.
2. Je te montre la liste et la place con: 2. I show you the list and the space involved: you confirm once (or you cancel, and nothing moves).
Ce que je ne fais jamais ici : vider la: What I never do here: empty the Recycle Bin, touch an open browser, change startup, the registry, Windows settings or services. These areas are never part of the quick tidy-up.
Coche = le service est actif ; décoche =: Ticked = the service is active; unticked = it will be disabled. Nothing changes until you confirm the preview. Vital Windows services are deliberately NOT in this list.
Coche un réglage pour l'appliquer, décoc: Tick a setting to apply it, untick it to go back to how it was. You see a preview before confirming, and only your account is affected.
Copies temporaires de pages, images et s: Temporary copies of pages, images and scripts already visited with Brave, kept to speed up display.
Temporary copies of pages, images and scripts already visited with Google Chrome, kept to speed up display.

Des petits coups de pouce doux, jamais i: Little gentle nudges, never pushy. Everything is disabled until you turn it on. ⚠️ TidyDeck must stay open to remind you: minimize it to the taskbar, but don't close it, otherwise no reminder will go out.
Désinstalle les applications préinstallé: Uninstall useless preinstalled applications. (Advanced mode only — nothing is deleted until you confirm the preview)
Exception unique et assumée : vider la C: One single, assumed exception: emptying the Recycle Bin is immediate and final. TidyDeck tells you explicitly every time the Recycle Bin is in the selection.
Fichiers de travail laissés par les prog: Working files left by programs (installers, open documents, unzipped archives...).
Fichiers que tu as déjà supprimés mais q: Files you already deleted but that still take up space.
Les détails techniques de ta machine : p: The technical details of your machine: processor, RAM, graphics card, disks.

Mode Discret : il masque à l'écran ce qu: Discreet mode: it hides on screen what TidyDeck displays. Not other applications' notifications, nor what Windows sends to Microsoft. Don't count on it for anything else.
Privilèges : les fonctions qui demandent: Privileges: functions that need elevation ask for it explicitly, once, and Windows asks for your consent again. Nothing is elevated without your consent.
Rappels : ils ne fonctionnent que si Tid: Reminders: they only work while TidyDeck stays open (minimized to the taskbar). TidyDeck cannot warn you when it is closed, and does not promise to.
Réversibilité : les fichiers nettoyés so: Reversibility: cleaned files are quarantined and undoable for the chosen period (7 days by default), from the Logs page.
Tout ce que TidyDeck a fait est noté ici: Everything TidyDeck has done is logged here. Select a line then click 'Undo'.
Transfère tes préférences d'un PC à l'au: Transfer your preferences from one PC to another in a flash, or keep a backup copy.
Trie tes Téléchargements, repère les gro: Sorts your Downloads, spots large forgotten files and traces of uninstalled apps. Nothing is deleted: files are moved or quarantined (undoable).
Un coup de main pour nettoyer, ranger et: A helping hand to clean, tidy and calm your PC — without breaking anything, without judging you.
Un état des lieux clair, et pour chaque: A clear state of play, and for each point: what to do. The information is at the top.
Vie privée : aucun compte, aucune inscri: Privacy: no account, no sign-up, no collection and no telemetry. No data ever leaves your machine: the only network access is the 'Updates' button, and it only starts if you click it.
